positions.title: Chief Executive Officer & Co-Founder
positions.description:
ThinxNet develops and operates TankTaler - the leading user-driven connected car platform in Europe.

TankTaler platform connects cars with their drivers and with industry partners. The technology comprises of a smartphone app (Android/iOS) and an OBD2 diagnostic connector, which can be plugged in any car built after 2001. Our platform offers multiple benefits free to consumers, such as:
- paying directly at the gas pump via our app without having to wait in line inside the shop
- getting reward points for topping-up, visiting partner retail locations or buying services/products via the app
- Getting immediate help in case of an accident via our emergency call (eCall) solution
- Having full control of their car: location, battery and engine health, drive log, alarms and statistics

company.name: ryd
company.tagline: With ryd we are changing payment and mobility forever. Making life easier, faster and safer.
company.description:
ryd is a company operating across Europe in the field of mobile payment. With ryd pay, we operate the largest open B2C network for mobile payment in Europe. Working with our partners Mastercard, BP, Mercedes-Benz and Axa, we are committed to changing the mobility and payment of the future.
The ryd ecosystem currently includes refueling, car wash and EV charging — accessible via the app or the infotainment system. There's no longer any need to visit the service station store. Payments are fast, convenient, and secure.
In addition to the ryd app, ryd is available through partner integrations with third-party providers, including navigation system and smartphone app providers, as well as car manufacturers. Founded in Munich in 2014, ryd has been growing steadily and has already launched in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Denmark, Portugal, and Spain, with further rollouts planned across other European countries.
